segments.text: Why is the back of your fridge warm?
It uses electricity to squeeze the gas.
Squeezing the gas makes it hotter.
It becomes a hot, high-pressure stream.
This hot gas moves to the condenser.
The compressor acts like a tiny engine.
It pushes the gas through copper tubes.
The force creates the high pressure.
The result is a hot gas.
It is ready to dump its heat.
The compressor is powered by electricity.
